name: codegraph
description: Semantic code intelligence for Codex through a local CodeGraph index and MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Local semantic code intelligence for precise repository answers.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the CodeGraph CLI and its codegraph_explore MCP tool. Codex proactively maps cross-file edits and investigations in indexed projects, follows calls, dependencies, routes, and impact, injects a hardcoded reminder to use the codegraph skill at SessionStart, and auto-syncs indexed projects as files change.
defaultPrompt: Before editing this feature, use CodeGraph to map its entry point, callers, callees, and tests.
Use CodeGraph first to trace this bug's route and identify the smallest safe change.
Use CodeGraph to explain how this repository's request flow works.
